summary:
Implementation Plan for Developer Credentials Isolation & Production Telegram MTProto Backend Integration:
1. Developer Credentials Configuration: Move API ID and API Hash completely off the user UI into server/config.ts and .env / .env.example, giving the developer a single clear configuration point.
2. Login UI Cleanup: Remove API ID & API Hash inputs from TelegramLoginModal so end users only see a clean, authentic Telegram Phone Number + OTP Code interface.
3. Backend MTProto Connection & Diagnostics: Enhance server/telegramService.ts with real MTProto DC connection status, detailed error reporting (invalid phone, rate limit, DC migration), and live health check endpoint (/api/telegram/status).
4. Direct Guide for User: Provide exact file path and instructions where the developer inserts their official Telegram api_id and api_hash.
